name: Female 01 (level narrator)
sounds_like: Mid female at 196 Hz held inside a narrow 5.7-semitone range - the flattest, most level delivery of any female voice here. Dark for its pitch (centroid 1445 Hz, 85% of energy below 2638 Hz), so it reads chesty rather than bright. Very clean, no audible breath (flatness 0.0009). Drops full 1.0s beats between sentences; 21% of the clip is silence. Reads literary prose in an even, unhurried, audiobook manner.
casts_well_as: Audiobook or cold-open narration, briefing officer, measured authority, a woman who does not raise her voice, clinical or procedural exposition.
avoid_for: Excitement, banter, comedy, or grief - there is not enough pitch movement in the reference to sell any of them.
note: Mapped to woman_sharp and char_casca in scripts/make_audio_library.py. Measured from the wav; delivery read from female/female_01.reference.txt, a Treasure Island passage.
